title: Learning the Channel Gain from Anywhere to Anywhere via Cross-environment Transformer Estimators
abstract: arXiv:2605.08211v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Channel-gain maps provide the channel gain between any two locations in a geographical region. They find numerous applications, from resource allocation and interference control to path planning for autonomous vehicles. Channel-gain map estimation (CGME) is considerably more challenging than conventional radio map estimation (RME) because channel-gain maps are functions over a 6-dimensional input space. This calls for specialized methods, which currently rely on the (inaccurate) radio tomographic model or require a prohibitively large number of measurements since they do not exploit any spatial structure. This paper overcomes this issue by leveraging spatial patterns that channel-gain maps exhibit across environments, as dictated by the laws of physics and typical environmental characteristics (e.g. building materials and layouts). translated_title: 基于跨环境Transformer估计器的任意位置间信道增益学习
translated_abstract: 信道增益图提供了地理区域内任意两个位置之间的信道增益，其应用广泛，涵盖资源分配、干扰控制以及自动驾驶车辆的路径规划等。信道增益图估计（CGME）比传统的无线电地图估计（RME）更具挑战性，因为信道增益图是定义在6维输入空间上的函数，这需要专门的方法。然而，现有的专门方法要么依赖于（不准确的）无线电层析模型，要么由于未利用任何空间结构而需要极其大量的测量数据。本文通过利用信道增益图在不同环境间所呈现的空间模式来克服这一问题，这些模式由物理定律和典型的环境特征（如建筑材料和布局）所决定。本文采用元学习的视角，提出了一种基于Transformer的估计器，以隐式地学习……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的跨环境元学习估计器，通过学习信道增益图在不同环境间共有的空间模式，以远少于现有方法的测量数据实现地理区域内任意位置间信道增益的准确估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-environment, metalearning-based transformer estimator that exploits spatial patterns shared by channel-gain maps across different environments to accurately estimate channel gains between any two locations with far fewer measurements than existing methods.
